lines.text: The LORD has established His throne in heaven,
and His kingdom rules over all.
Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength
who hearken to the voice of His command.
Bless the LORD, all His hosts,
you servants who do His will.
Bless the LORD, all His works
in all places of His dominion.
Bless the LORD, O my soul!

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Holy Trinity — the Father holding the Son with the dove above them and the angels all around, the LORD has established His throne in heaven
pictures.name: pd_greco_troon

pictures.scene: Pietro Perugino, The Archangel Michael — the archangel standing in full armour with his sword and the scales hanging beside him, bless the LORD all His angels mighty in strength
pictures.name: pd_perugino_engelen

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Defeat of Sennacherib — the angels coming down out of the light on the army in the night and the horses going over, who carry out His word
pictures.name: pd_rubens_woord

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, the Ghent Altarpiece: The Adoration of the Mystic Lamb — the Lamb on the altar with rank on rank of angels and saints kneeling in the meadow, bless the LORD all His hosts
pictures.name: pd_eyck_heirscharen

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, View of Haarlem with Bleaching Grounds — a whole country of fields and cottages and one church tower under an immense sky, bless the LORD all His works in all places of His dominion
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_werken

pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, Simeon's Song of Praise — the old man holding the child in the one shaft of light in the temple and singing, bless the LORD O my soul
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_ziel
